gui.abyssalcraft.necronomicon.intro.text: This ancient tome holds the collected knowledge of the abyssal dimensions, their denizens, and the dark rituals that bind them. Turn the pages to learn - but be warned, for knowledge always has its price.
gui.abyssalcraft.necronomicon.ac.title: Bienvenue dans AbyssalCraft !
gui.abyssalcraft.necronomicon.ac.text: AbyssalCraft draws you into the mythos of the Great Old Ones: a journey through corrupted dimensions, forbidden rituals, and the pursuit of Potential Energy. This book is your guide along the abyssal path.
gui.abyssalcraft.necronomicon.goo.title: les Grands Anciens
gui.abyssalcraft.necronomicon.goo.text: The Great Old Ones are ancient deities that slumber beyond the veil of reality. Their influence seeps into the world through the abyssal dimensions. Chief among those you will face is Cthulhu, and beyond him wait the Outer Gods.
Knowledge is gained by experiencing the abyss firsthand - slaying its creatures, treading its dimensions, and studying relics at the Crystallizer. As your understanding grows, more of this book reveals itself.
gui.abyssalcraft.necronomicon.abyssal_wa: The first abyssal dimension: a barren expanse of abyssal stone beneath an eternal dusk. Coralium infests its swamps and lakes, and shadow creatures roam freely. It is reached through a gateway of coralium-infused stone.
gui.abyssalcraft.necronomicon.dreadlands: A corrupted red wasteland born of the Dread Plague, where dreadium ore lies buried and the Dreadguards patrol. The very ground, dreadstone, is steeped in death. Only the well-prepared endure here.
gui.abyssalcraft.necronomicon.omothol.te: The realm of the Gatekeepers: shattered stone islands adrift in a pale void. Here dwells J'zahar, the Gatekeeper of the Abyss, guarding the way onward. A place of judgment and terrible power.
gui.abyssalcraft.necronomicon.dark_realm: The deepest abyss: a lightless void of darkstone where Sacthoth, Harbinger of Doom, awaits. Few who enter return, and none return unchanged. This is the end of the abyssal path.

necronomicon.text.azathoth.1: Azathoth, le Sultan des Démons, est le Maître des autres Dieux et probablement le créateur de toute existence.
necronomicon.text.azathoth.2: Il réside au centre de l'Univers, au-delà de l'espace-temps, baignant dans un son de flûte irréel. Il a une âme et une volonté, et chacun de ses désirs est immédiatement exaucé par Nyarlathotep.
necronomicon.text.nyarlathotep.1: Nyarlathotep, le Chaos Rampant, est un Autre Dieu qui n'est ni exilé ni emprisonné.
necronomicon.text.nyarlathotep.2: Il erre sur Terre parmi les Humains, répandant folie et démence. Il sert le culte des Autres Dieux, et exécute la volonté de son maître Azathoth.
necronomicon.text.yog-sothoth.1: Yog-Sothoth, le Tout en Un et l'Un en Tout, est un Autre Dieu, descendant des Brumes de l'Immonde.
necronomicon.text.yog-sothoth.2: Il est très probable, pour ne pas dire certain, que Yog-Sothoth soit omniscient, et est exilé en-dehors de l'Univers; il peut voir l'espace-temps entier en même temps, et il est impossible de lui cacher quoi que ce soit.
necronomicon.text.shub-niggurath.1: Shub-Niggurath, la Chèvre Noire des Bois aux mille Chevreaux, est un Autre Dieu.
necronomicon.text.shub-niggurath.2: Elle incarne la fécondité malsaine et corrompue. Elle est dite apparaître comme étant une masse énorme couverte de tentacules noirs, mâchoires suintant d'un liquide visqueux, et de courtes pattes de chèvres. De petits creétures s'en échappent continuellement, et sont soit assimilées à nouveau soit s'enfuient.
necronomicon.text.cthulhu.1: Cthulhu est un Grand Ancien, dormant pour l'éternité dans sa cité engloutie de R'lyeh.
necronomicon.text.cthulhu.2: Il a la tête d'un poulpe, un corps écailleux et des ailes dans le dos. Son sommeil éternel est la preuve de sa défaite lors d'une querre sans merci contre les "Choses Très Anciennes", qui s'est terminée quand R'lyeh fut engloutie par les océans Un jour, il se réveillera, et dominera le monde entier.
necronomicon.text.hastur.1: Hastur l'Indicible est un Grand Ancien, demi-frère de Cthulhu.
necronomicon.text.hastur.2: On sait peut de choses de lui, mais on sait qu'il apparaît généralement sous la forme d'un Roi masqué drapé de jaune. Commela plupart des Grands Anciens, il est capable de changer de forme à volonté.
necronomicon.text.jzahar.1: J'zahar, le Gardien des Abysses, est la descendance illégitime d'Hastur.
necronomicon.text.jzahar.2: Assoiffé de pouvoir et refusant l'exil, J'zahar a fusionné avec l'espace-temps pour fuir son sort. Il a obtenu un pouvoir similaire à celui de Yog-Sothoth, mais son châtiment fut celui de garder les Dieux et Grands Anciens pour l'éternité.
L'Abyssalnite est un nouveau minerai trouvable profondément sous les Terres de l'Ombre. Les lingots, violets comme le minerai lui-même, sont plus résistants que le diamant et permettent de créer outils, armes et armure. Il est trouvable en-dessous de Y=32.
necronomicon.text.materials.darkstone.1: Darkstone is a new type of stone found in Darklands biomes. Darklands Mountains are made out of this stone. The Dark Realm also consists of this material. When mined, it drops Darkstone Cobblestone, and it can be turned into Darkstone Bricks.
necronomicon.text.materials.darkstone.2: This material is slightly stronger than regular stone, and tools made from it are stronger than their counterparts.
necronomicon.text.materials.coralium.1: Coralium is a new ore found in ocean biomes and swamp biomes. The gems from it has multiple uses, among them the creation of Coralium Pearls.
necronomicon.text.materials.coralium.2: Large amounts of gems can be used to create Coralium Chunks, which can be smelted down for Refined Coralium Ingots. Coralium Pearls are required to create the first Gateway Key, used to reach the first dimension, the Abyssal Wasteland.
necronomicon.text.materials.darklandsoak: Darklands Oak is a new tree commonly found in Darklands biomes. It's wood can be used to create planks, which can be used to craft stairs, slabs and fences. Compared to the normal Oak wood, it's darker in color, and could thus be more stylish in design patterns, shifting the different wood types.
necronomicon.text.materials.nitre.1: Nitre is a new ore found randomly in the Overworld. It can be used to create gunpowder, but doesn't have that many uses past that. It can be crystallized into Potassium and Nitrate crystals.
necronomicon.text.materials.liquidantima: Liquid Antimatter is a new liquid found underground in Coralium Infested Swamps. It has the ability to de-materialize entities, and can also force other liquids to solidify upon collision.

If you happen to fall into a pool of Liquid Antimatter, you will likely die within approximately 5 seconds, as it deals a large amount of damage in a very short time, making it quite hard to avoid certain death when getting in contact with it.
In order to reach the Abyssal Wasteland, one must craft a Gateway Key, which requires one to travel to the Nether, and to visit a Darklands and a water-based biome. The water-based biome can be either a swamp or a ocean biome.

From the Nether you need 2 Blaze Rods, and probably a few more for later. From the Darklands biome you need to slay living shadows to finally obtain Shadow Gems. They are most commonly found in Darklands Mountains biomes. It is recommended to obtain a Staff of Rending in order to obtain Shadow Gems faster (more information in the special armor and tools section).

From the water-based biome you need Coralium Gems in order to create Coralium Pearls. Once you have obtained these items, you can create a Transmutation Gem through an Infusion Ritual (found in the ritual section). The recipe for Shards of Oblivion can be found in the special materials section.

When you have 4 Shards of Oblivion, use those and 4 units of Redstone Dust to infuse an Eye of Ender (through an infusion ritual, found in the ritual section of the Necronomicon) in order to create an Oblivion Catalyst, main component of the Gateway Key (the special materials section has the recipe).
Once the Gateway Key is crafted, you can create portals through the Ritual of Open Doors (check the ritual section of the Necronomicon for more information).

For more information, you will need the Abyssal Wasteland Necronomicon, which requires 8 Skins of The Abyssal Wasteland in order to upgrade. The Staff of Rending is needed in order to obtain essences used to craft those.
necronomicon.text.entity.abyssalzombie.1: Abyssal Zombies can be found in various Ocean, Swamp, Beach and Darklands biomes.
necronomicon.text.entity.abyssalzombie.2: Abyssal Zombies are formerly Zombies who has been infected with the Coralium Plague, causing them to evolve into these beings. They are hostile against regular Zombies. They also spawn in the Abyssal Wasteland and the End.
necronomicon.text.entity.depthsghoul.1: Depths Ghouls are evolved Coralium Infested undead. Spawns where Abyssal Zombies spawn.
necronomicon.text.entity.depthsghoul.2: Depths Ghouls are the masterpiece of Coralium Plague evolution on Zombies, rarely mutating into these behemoths. Some of them gains new forms, such as Pete, Mr. Wilson and Dr. Orange, each stronger than the other.
Shadow Creatures are inhabitants of The Dark Realm, can be found in Darklands Mountains.

Shadow Creatures are living shadows naturally found in The Dark Realm, but are capable of merging to Omothol and all the way to the Darklands. The Shadow Creature is the smallest evolution of living shadows.
necronomicon.text.entity.shadowmonster.1: Shadow Monsters are inhabitants of The Dark Realm, can be found in Darklands Mountains.
necronomicon.text.entity.shadowmonster.2: Shadow Monsters are living shadows naturally found in The Dark Realm, but are capable of merging to Omothol and all the way to the Darklands. The Shadow Monster is the middle evolution of living shadows.
necronomicon.text.entity.shadowbeast.1: Shadow Beasts are inhabitants of The Dark Realm, can be found in Darklands Mountains.
necronomicon.text.entity.shadowbeast.2: Shadow Beasts are living shadows naturally found in The Dark Realm, but are capable of merging to Omothol and all the way to the Darklands. The Shadow Beast is the greater evolution of living shadows.
necronomicon.text.entity.anti.1: Inside the Coralium Infested Swamp you can find several life forms made out of antimatter.
necronomicon.text.entity.anti.2: If a anti-entity collides with it's normal counterpart, they explode. There are anti-versions of: Zombies, Abyssal Zombies, Skeletons, Depths Ghouls, Bats, Cows, Pigs, Chickens, Creepers, Spiders and Players. Anti-Players don't explode.
necronomicon.text.entity.evilanimals.1: If you encounter any of these animals, you will quickly notice that it's hostile and screams when you hit it.
necronomicon.text.entity.evilanimals.2: The Evil Animals are pre-evolving Demon Animals, which hatches when you kill the current animal-based organism. They are immune to fire, and spawn in most Overworld biomes.
necronomicon.text.entity.shuboffspring.1: Dark Offspring are vile beasts resembling a goat mixed with a dead tree, and are the offspring of Shub-Niggurath.
necronomicon.text.entity.shuboffspring.2: These beasts can rarely be found in forests (most common in Roofed Forests and Darklands Forests). You know you're getting close to one if you start hearing sheep out of nowhere. You're most likely to encounter one at night during a new moon.
Lesser Shoggoths are a smaller breed of Shoggoths found throughout the Abyss.

Shoggoths are amorphous shapeshifting beings genetically engineered by the Elder Things as a race of servant-tools. Though being mindless, they became conscious and killed their masters. Now they sometimes build monoliths in honor of The Great Old Ones.
necronomicon.text.crafting.coraliuminfus: Coralium Infused Stone is crafted with Coralium Gem Clusters and Stone. The three clusters can be of any size, but must add up to 9.
If you use a 9-gem cluster, surround it with Stone blocks instead of 2 rows. When this block is broken (or smelt) you get a Coralium Pearl.
necronomicon.text.crafting.shadowgem.1: A Shadow Gem is crafted with Shadow Gem Shards. The Shards are crafted the same way, but with Shadow Fragments.
necronomicon.text.crafting.shadowgem.2: Shadow Fragments are dropped by Shadow Creatures, Shadow Gem Shards are dropped by Shadow Monsters and Shadow Gems are dropped by Shadow Beasts. They spawn in Darklands Mountains biomes and the Dark Realm.
necronomicon.text.crafting.oblivionshard: A Shard of Oblivion is crafted with Shadow Gems and a Transmutation Gem.
necronomicon.text.crafting.gk1: The Gateway Key is crafted with Blaze Rods, Coralium Pearls and a Oblivion Catalyst.
necronomicon.text.crafting.skin_aby: A Skin of The Abyssal Wasteland is crafted with Coralium-plagued Flesh and a Essence of The Abyssal Wasteland. The essence is obtained through the use of a Staff of Rending.
necronomicon.text.crafting.necro_c: A Abyssal Wasteland Necronomicon is crafted with Skin of The Abyssal Wasteland and a Necronomicon. It contains more knowledge.
A Staff of Rending is crafted with Shadow Gem Shards and a Shard of Oblivion. It can harvest energy from certain entities (by right clicking).

Abyssal Wasteland Energy can be harvested from any Coralium entity inside the Abyssal Wasteland. Dreadlands Energy can be harvested from any Dread entity inside the Dreadlands. Omothol Energy can be harvested from any entity inside Omothol. Shadow Energy are harvested from any living shadow. Essences are created when sufficient energy is collected.
necronomicon.text.crafting.sequential_br: A Sequential Brewing Stand is crafted using Blaze Rods, a Hopper and Brewing Stands. Sequential Brewing Stands can be chained, allowing one to transfer its output to the next one.

A pipe indicates the direction of transfer, and the pipes will connect on two connected Brewing Stands. Automation exists for ingredient input on the top, fuel and bottle input on the sides and output of the output slots on the bottom.
necronomicon.information.overworld.title: La Surface
necronomicon.text.overworld: De nouveaux biomes ont été ajoutés à la Surface, dont notamment les Terres de l'Ombre mais également les Marécages Infestés. Vous pourrez aussi rencontrer des Goules et Zombies Abyssaux, provenant des Landes Abyssales.
necronomicon.text.materials.abyssalstone: Abyssal Stone is a new type of stone that the Abyssal Wasteland is made out of. You need iron tools or better to break it. Compared to other stone types, it is resistant to the transmutation produced by Liquid Coralium, and it can be turned into Abyssal Stone Bricks. Drops Abyssal Cobblestone when mined.
necronomicon.text.materials.abyssalsand: Abyssal Sand is found around the surface layers of the Abyssal Wasteland. It can be smelted into Abyssal Sand Glass, which is green.
necronomicon.text.materials.fusedabyssal: Fused Abyssal Sand covers the surface of the Abyssal Wasteland. It's glassy texture is formed from the sand reacting to the atmosphere of the dimension.
Inside the Abyssal Wasteland, you can find "abyssal" versions of ores found in the Overworld, which drops an abyssal version of their overworld counterpart's drops, if not the same.
There's an abyssal version of Iron, Gold, Diamond, Copper, Tin and Nitre ores. They generate at a similar heigh to their overworld counterparts.
necronomicon.text.materials.abyssalcoral: Abyssal Coralium is a variant of Coralium found within the Abyssal Wasteland. It is almost identical to it's overworld counterpart. Much like the regular Coralium Ore, the Abyssal Coralium Ore drops Coralium Gems, which has multiple uses. Generates around Y = 55 and below.
necronomicon.text.materials.liquifiedcor: Liquified Coralium is a variant of Coralium found within the Abyssal Wasteland. Compared to the other variants, it doesn't drop Coralium Gems when mined. When mined, the dropped ore can be smelted down for Refined Coralium Ingots. Generates around Y = 22 and below.
necronomicon.text.materials.pearlescentc: Pearlescent Coralium is a variant of Coralium found within the Abyssal Wasteland. This variant drops Coralium Pearls when mined, instead of Coralium Gems. Due to the item gained from the ore, it is quite rare, and generates around Y = 10 and below.
necronomicon.text.materials.liquidcorali: Liquid Coralium is a new liquid found within the Abyssal Wasteland. It has the ability to transmute elements on contact, as in converting any water-based liquid into itself, and most stone types into Abyssal Stone.

It also infects entities that touches it with the Coralium Plague, killing them if they aren't immune. Some entities can be converted into Abyssal Zombies on death. If the liquid collides with Liquid Antimatter, it will convert into Coralium Stone.
necronomicon.text.materials.powerstonedr: Dreadlands Infused Powerstone is a special stone found deep within Abyssal Strongholds. You need a pickaxe stronger or equal to a Refined Coralium Pickaxe in order to mine it. Once mined, it can be used to upgrade your Gateway Key if you have the other components.
necronomicon.text.abyssal.progression.1: Once you have reached the Abyssal Wasteland, your next goal is to reach the Dreadlands. You will need 3 components in order to upgrade your Gateway Key, an Eye of The Abyss, a Dreadlands Infused Powerstone and a Transmutation Gem. The first is obtained by defeating Asorah, The Fallen, summoned through the ritual "Ritual of The Sleeper" (in ritual section).
necronomicon.text.abyssal.progression.2: Asorah uses Spectral Dragons to heal himself, so they should be taken out quickly throughout the fight. Once defeated, Asorah will drop his eye with a large quantity of exp and materials found in the dimension. The Dreadlands Infused Powerstone is located inside a Abyssal Stronghold, which can be found using Powerstone Trackers (recipe in special materials section).
necronomicon.text.abyssal.progression.3: Once you have tracked down the Powerstone, you can mine it with a Refined Coralium Pickaxe. Lastly you can upgrade your Gateway Key by infusing it with the required components ("Asorah's Dreaded Gateway Key" ritual). Upgrading your Necronomicon to the Dreadlands Necronomicon requires 8 Skins of The Dreadlands.
necronomicon.text.entity.skeletongoliath: Skeleton Goliaths are massive Skeletons with Cudgels roaming the Abyssal Wasteland. Unknown Origin.

Ever thought what a giant skeleton with a Cudgel would look like in Minecraft? Well, this. Skeleton Goliaths are big and powerful skeletons walking among the dead. They have a small chance of dropping the Cudgel on death.
Spectral Dragons are transparent dragons rarely spawning in the Abyssal Wasteland.

These ghastly dragons are mostly a nuisance to face, but probably more tricky when Asorah devours their life energy in order to regenerate himself. They can fly through solid matter without destroying it, unlike the Ender Dragon.
necronomicon.text.entity.asorah.1: Asorah, The Fallen, is the first boss encountered in AbyssalCraft. Summoned inside the Abyssal Wasteland.
necronomicon.text.entity.asorah.2: Asorah was formerly Oblivionaire's dragon, until he passed away aeons ago, after that he has been reanimated through the usage of Coralium until he was destroyed by an unknown enemy. Now his soul resides in the Dark Realm.
necronomicon.text.entity.coraliumsquid.1: Coralium Infested Squids are found in pools of Liquid Coralium inside the Abyssal Wasteland.
necronomicon.text.entity.coraliumsquid.2: These Squids have been transformed by the Coralium Plague, enabling them to transfer it to victims touched by them, or the ink they squirt on their targets.
necronomicon.text.crafting.psdltracker: A Powerstone Tracker is crafted with Coralium Gems and a Eye of Ender.
A Transmutator is crafted with Coralium Bricks, Blocks of Refined Coralium, a Transutation Gem and a Liquid Coralium Bucket.
To obtain Coralium Bricks, you must pour Liquid Antimatter on Liquid Coralium, then harvest the stone formed from the Liquid Coralium. Then you must smelt the Coralium Stone for Coralium Bricks.
necronomicon.text.crafting.coraliumchunk: A Chunk of Coralium is crafted with 9-gem Coralium Clusters and an Abyssal Stone.
necronomicon.text.crafting.coraliumplate: A Coralium Plate is crafted with Refined Coralium Ingots and Coralium Pearls.
necronomicon.text.crafting.skin_dre: A Skin of The Dreadlands is crafted with Dread Fragment and a Essence of The Dreadlands. The essence is obtained through the use of a Staff of Rending.
necronomicon.text.crafting.necro_d: A Dreadlands Necronomicon is crafted with Skin of The Dreadlands and a Abyssal Wasteland Necronomicon.
necronomicon.text.crafting.corhelmetp: A Plated Coralium Helmet is crafted with Coralium Pearls, Refined Coralium Ingots, Coralium Plates and a Refined Coralium Helmet.
necronomicon.text.crafting.corplatep: A Plated Coralium Chestplate is crafted with Refined Coralium Ingots, Coralium Plates and a Refined Coralium Chestplate.
necronomicon.text.crafting.corlegsp: Plated Coralium Leggings are crafted with Refined Coralium Ingots, Coralium Plates and Refined Coralium Leggings.
necronomicon.text.crafting.corbootsp: Plated Coralium Boots are crafted with Refined Coralium Ingots, Coralium Plates and Refined Coralium Boots.
necronomicon.text.crafting.corbow: A Coralium Longbow is crafted with Strings, Refined Coralium Ingots, a Coralium Pearl and a Bow.
necronomicon.text.coraliumplague.1: The Coralium Plague is a disease originating from the Abyssal Wasteland. It's capable of transforming infected victims on death into stronger monsters. It's only considered a plague by those harmed by it.
necronomicon.text.coraliumplague.2: An antidote for the Coralium Plague can be made with a Water Bottle, a Wasteland's Thorn, a piece of Coralium-plagued Flesh and a piece of Abyssal Shoggoth Flesh.
necronomicon.information.abyssal.title: Les Landes Abyssales
necronomicon.text.abyssal: Ce lieu est la première dimension des Abysses: un endroit sombre, vert, et peuplé de morts-vivants. Oblivionaire a probablement régné sur ce lieu, ou bien son dragon Asorah. Très certainment l'endroit d'où vient le Coralium.
necronomicon.text.materials.dreadstone.1: Dreadstone is a stone found commonly in the Dreadlands. It was formerly Abyssalnite Stone that was converted by the Dread Plague aeons ago. You can turn it into Dreadstone Bricks. It is also used in when crafting the Altar of Cha'garoth.
necronomicon.text.materials.abyssalnites: Abyssalnite Stone is a stone found within the Purified Dreadlands biome inside the Dreadlands. You can turn it into Abyssalnite Stone Bricks.
This was formerly what the Dreadlands was made out of before it became the Dreadlands, since the dimension was once a gigantic mine hosting the largest amount of pure Abyssalnite.
necronomicon.text.materials.dreadlandsab: Dreadlands Abyssalnite is a variant of Abyssalnite found in the Dreadlands. The ore gained from mining it can be smelted for Abyssalnite Ingots. Ironically enough, based on the conditions where this ore exist, this is the purest form of Abyssalnite Ore found anywhere.
necronomicon.text.materials.dreadedabyss: Dreaded Abyssalnite is a variant of Abyssalnite found in the Dreadlands. The ore gained from mining it can be smelted for Abyssalnite Ingots. If you crystallize this ore, you can get Dreadium Crystals, as this form of Abyssalnite has been corrupted by the Dread Plague.
necronomicon.text.materials.dreadlandsgr: Dreadlands Grass is a type of grass that grows in Dreadlands Forest biomes within the Dreadlands. Compared to regular grass, it is red.
necronomicon.text.materials.dreadlandstr: Dreadlands Tree is a tree commonly found in Dreadlands Forest biomes inside the Dreadlands. It's wood can be used to make planks, which can be used to craft stairs, slabs and fence. Compared to the Oak, both the leaves and logs are red.
necronomicon.text.dreadlands.progression: Once you have reached the Dreadlands, your next goal is to reach Omothol. You will need to own a Transmutator, and you need to defeat Cha'garoth, The Dreadbeast. In order to reach Cha'garoth, you need the Altar of Cha'garoth, made out of 2 pieces. Both pieces are created through rituals.

Once you have both Altar pieces, you need to place them at Y = 40 inside a Dreadlands Mountain biome and right-click it. Doing so will grant you entry to The Lair of Cha'garoth. After fighting through Dreadguards and eventually killing Cha'garoth, you will receive a Dread-plagued Gateway Key, along with loot. The key needs to be transmuted into a functioning one.

With the aforementioned Transmutator (recipe in Abyssal Wasteland special materials section) you can transmute the Dread-plagued Gateway Key into Cha'garoth's R'lyehian Gateway Key, granting you access to Omothol. Upgrading your Necronomicon to the Omothol Necronomicon requires 8 Skins of Omothol.
necronomicon.text.entity.dreadling.1: Dreadlings are mutated beings found in the Dreadlands.
necronomicon.text.entity.dreadling.2: These beings were once Abyssalnite miners in the dimension that became the Dreadlands. They have no memory of their past, and now lives to worship Cha'garoth, The Dreadbeast, who controls them.
necronomicon.text.entity.dreadspawn.1: Dread Spawns are mutated beings found in the Dreadlands. They are rumored to share certain genetic features with Shoggoths.
necronomicon.text.entity.dreadspawn.2: It is not known what these beings are, but one thing is sure, Cha'garoth created them. Dread Spawns are slowly crawling mutants appearing often in Dreadlands Forests. If enough of them group up at one spot, they might merge, growing into a larger mass.
necronomicon.text.entity.demonanimals.1: Demon Animals are demonic monsters found in the Nether and the Dreadlands.
necronomicon.text.entity.demonanimals.2: These abominations are commonly found in Dreadlands Forests or randomly in the Nether. How these monsters were created is unknown, but someone hated humans enough to turn farm animals hostile against them.
Spawns of Cha'garoth are mutated beings found in the Dreadlands.

Compared to the Dread Spawn, these mutated beings are the offspring of Cha'garoth, having a few of his features. They are stronger than their lesser counterpart (the Dread Spawn), and are usually spawned by Cha'garoth.
necronomicon.text.entity.chagarothfist.1: Fists of Cha'garoths are living hands found in the Dreadlands.
necronomicon.text.entity.chagarothfist.2: As the Dreadbeast is immobile, he managed to create arms that stretched almost infinitely across the Dreadlands, with empty eyeballs for him to gaze through. This is literally a hand holding a eyeball.
necronomicon.text.entity.dreadguard.1: Dreadguards are powerful mutants found in the Dreadlands.
necronomicon.text.entity.dreadguard.2: These particular beings have been empowered by Cha'garoth, and placed in corrupted Abyssalnite Armor with the task of guarding their master, which they do quite well. They drop Dreaded Shards of Abyssalnite.
necronomicon.text.entity.chagaroth.1: Cha'garoth, The Dreadbeast, is the Second boss in AbyssalCraft, encountered in the Dreadlands.
necronomicon.text.entity.chagaroth.2: Cha'garoth is the result of a new dangerous virus, 3 chopped off hydra heads and a dead Shoggoth. Becoming a health hazard for The Great Old Ones, he was placed in the dimension that became the Dreadlands, killing and corrupting everything.
necronomicon.text.entity.dreadedghoul.1: Informations sur les goules contaminées par l'Effroi
necronomicon.text.entity.dreadedghoul.2: Plus d'informations sur les goules contaminées par l'Effroi
necronomicon.text.crafting.dreadium.1: Dreadium can be obtained in numerous ways. One method is to transmute Dreaded Shards of Abyssalnite (dropped by Dreadguards, Greater Dread Spawns and Lesser Dreadbeasts).
necronomicon.text.crafting.dreadium.2: When you have enough Dreadium Ingots to craft a Crystallizer, you can crystallize Dreaded materials to obtain Dreadium Crystals (mostly shards which you can combine into crystals that can be transmuted for Dreadium Ingots).
A Crystallizer is crafted using Dreadstone Bricks, Blocks of Dreadium and a Furnace.
Dreadium Ingots are obtained by transmuting Dreaded Shards of Abyssalnite, which are dropped by Dreadguards inside the Dreadlands. Dreadium is a lot easier to obtain once you have a Crystallizer.
necronomicon.text.crafting.dreadcloth: Dread Cloth is crafted with Dread Fragments, Strings and a piece of Leather.
necronomicon.text.crafting.dreadplate: A Dreadium Plate is crafted with Dreadium Ingots and a Dread Cloth.
necronomicon.text.crafting.dreadiumhilt: A Dreadium Katana Hilt is crafted with Dreadium Ingots, Dreadlands Wood Planks and Dread Cloth.
necronomicon.text.crafting.dreadiumblade: A Dreadium Katana Blade is crafted with Dreadium Crystals.
necronomicon.text.crafting.skin_omt: A Skin of Omothol is crafted with Omothol Ghoul Flesh and a Essence of Omothol. The essence is obtained through the use of a Staff of Rending.
necronomicon.text.crafting.necro_o: A Omothol Necronomicon is crafted with Skin of Omothol and a Dreadlands Necronomicon.
necronomicon.text.crafting.dreadiumshelm: A Dreadium Samurai Helmet is crafted with Dreadium Plates, a Dreadium Ingot and a Dreadium Helmet.
necronomicon.text.crafting.dreadiumsplat: A Dreadium Samurai Chestplate is crafted with Dreadium Plates, Dread Cloth, a Dreadium Ingot and a Dreadium Chestplate.
necronomicon.text.crafting.dreadiumslegs: Dreadium Samurai Leggings are crafted with Dreadium Plates, Dread Cloth and Dreadium Leggings.
necronomicon.text.crafting.dreadiumsboot: Dreadium Boots are crafted with Dread Cloth, Dreadlands Wood Planks and Dreadium Boots.
necronomicon.text.crafting.dreadiumkatan: A Dreadium Katana is crafted with a Dreadium Katana Blade and a Dreadium Katana Hilt.
necronomicon.text.dreadplague.1: The Dread Plague is a disease originating from the Dreadlands. It's a very infectious disease, swiftly travelling between hosts, but also transforming the ground around those afflicted by it, thus allowing the plague to grow stronger. The only place known to be completely immune to the Dread Plague is Omothol.
necronomicon.text.dreadplague.2: An antidote for the Dread Plague can be made with a Water Bottle, a Dreadlands Sapling, a Dread Fragment and a piece of Dreaded Shoggoth Flesh.
necronomicon.text.dreadlands: Il y a une éternité de cela, cet endroit était un monde d'Abyssalnite. Les Dreadlands reçurent leur nom lorsque Cha'garoth propagea l'Effroyable Peste Rouge, tuant et corrompant toute la dimension. La seconde dimension des Abysses est un lieu de sommeil des Âmes égarées.
necronomicon.text.materials.omotholstone: Omothol Stone is a new type of stone that Omothol is made out of. It can be combined with Ethaxium to create Dark Ethaxium.
necronomicon.text.materials.ethaxium.1: Ethaxium is a new material most commonly appearing in Omothol as the material used for structures built there. Ethaxium is extremely hard, and can thus only be destroyed with tools made from it.
necronomicon.text.materials.ethaxium.2: Ethaxium is said to be what souls are made out of, which likely explains why it's almost indestructible. No wonder J'zahar built his temple city from this.
necronomicon.text.materials.darkethaxium: Dark Ethaxium is a stronger version of Ethaxium created by combining regular Ethaxium with Omothol Stone. This kind of Ethaxium is harder than it's normal counterpart. This material is only used in one structure, the Temple of J'zahar.
necronomicon.text.omothol.progression.1: Now that you've arrived in Omothol, it's time to battle J'zahar, Gatekeeper of The Abyss. The Temple of J'zahar can be located at the heart of Omothol (coordinates X=4, Y=53, Z=7). Once you have defeated the Gatekeeper, you will be able to unlock all hidden knowledge through the Abyssalnomicon.
necronomicon.text.omothol.progression.2: The Abyssalnomicon requires Ethaxium Ingots, Eldritch Scales and the Essence of The Gatekeeper (dropped by J'zahar).
necronomicon.text.entity.remnant.1: Remnants are the citizens of Omothol, found there.
necronomicon.text.entity.remnant.2: Since all Great Old Ones has some type of offspring, J'zahar has the Remnants, whom are lesser beings of himself, incapable of obtaining the power he bears. Instead they worship him like his loyal breed, and trade goods with other life forms.
necronomicon.text.entity.omotholghoul.1: Omothol ghouls are the final evolution, found in Omothol.
necronomicon.text.entity.omotholghoul.2: The Omothol Ghoul is the final evolution of the Depths Ghoul, unlocking the full potential of death. Aeons in darkness has made these behemoths immune to fire, while strengthening them greatly.
necronomicon.text.entity.gatekeeperminio: Minions of The Gatekeeper are loyal servants to J'zahar found in Omothol.
Minions of The Gatekeeper are an elite of more powerful Remnants serving their master. They are commonly found around The Temple of J'zahar, being loyal minions to the Gatekeeper.
necronomicon.text.entity.jzahar.1: J'zahar, Gatekeeper of The Abyss, is the final boss in AbyssalCraft, found in Omothol.
necronomicon.text.entity.jzahar.2: J'zahar was the only one among The Great Old Ones to not get banished to the eternal void. Due to the powers he obtained when he reverted time and space to re-create it, he is tasked with guarding his fellow demonic gods in their eternal slumber.
necronomicon.text.crafting.lifecrystal.1: A Life Crystal is crafted with a Carbon, a Hydrogen, a Nitrogen, a Oxygen, a Phosphorus and a Sulfur Crystal.
necronomicon.text.crafting.lifecrystal.2: The Crystals are gained from crystallizing Coal, Water, Nitre, Rotten Flesh and Lapis Lazuli. The Nitrogen Crystal comes from Crystallizing the Nitrate Crystal from the Nitre.
necronomicon.text.crafting.ethaxiumingot: A Ethaxium Ingot is crafted with Ethaxium Bricks and a Life Crystal.

Ethaxium Bricks are gained from smelting Ethaxium, which is obtained by transmuting End Stone. Ethaxium Ingots can also be crafted with a Oblivion Catalyst surrounded by 4 Ethaxium Bricks, sparing 4 Ethaxium Bricks.
necronomicon.text.crafting.ethaxiumpilla: Ethaxium Pillars are crafted with Ethaxium Bricks and Ethaxium blocks
necronomicon.text.crafting.darkethaxiump: Dark Ethaxium Pillars are crafted with Dark Ethaxium Bricks and Omothol Stone
necronomicon.text.crafting.coin: A Coin is crafted with a piece of Flint and Iron Ingots. Can also be crafted with Tin and Copper Ingots.
necronomicon.text.crafting.crystalbag.1: A Crystal bag is crafted with Leather and a Gold Ingot.
necronomicon.text.crafting.crystalbag.2: They can be upgraded to hold more crystals by surrounding it with Coralium Plagued Flesh, Dread Fragments, then Omothol Ghoul Flesh.
A Materializer is crafted with Ethaxium Bricks, Obsidian, Blocks of Ethaxium and a Liquid Antimatter Bucket.
To use a Materializer, you need to place a Crystal Bag in the first slot, then a Necronomicon in the second, then you can create materials using the crystals inside the bag.
necronomicon.text.crafting.abyssalnomico: An Abyssalnomicon is crafted with Ethaxium Ingots, Eldritch Scales, a Essence of The Gatekeeper and a Omothol Necronomicon.
Eldritch Scales are gained from killing Remnants and Minions of The Gatekeeper.
necronomicon.text.itemtransportsystem.1: Spirit Tablet Shards can either be bought from Remnants or found as loot in buildings throughout Omothol. In a ritual involving 4 pieces and a Life Crystal, you can create a Spirit Tablet.
necronomicon.text.itemtransportsystem.2: The Spirit Tablet is a tool allowing you to move Items by having spirits possess them. The tablet comes with a bunch of keybindings used to switch modes, open the filter inventory, clear the current set path. The modes include one for setting paths, one for applying configurations and one for clearing them.
necronomicon.text.itemtransportsystem.3: The "Set Path" mode allows you to create a route for the items to move by right-clicking with the tablet on the ground. Sneak right-click on the desination block.
necronomicon.text.itemtransportsystem.4: You don't necessarily have to lay out a route if you don't want to, only selecting the destination block also works just fine. When the Spirit Tablet is in the "Set Path" mode, the selected path will display as a line of redstone particles (where the last selected position consist of green particles). The path can be cleared using a keybind (check the tooltip of the item).
necronomicon.text.itemtransportsystem.5: With a keybind (check the item tooltip), you can open an inventory to set a filter, which support up to 5 Items, subtypes (a Block of Stone would also filter for Andesite, Granite, etc), NBT (a piece of enchanted armor would only allow for other pieces of enchanted armor). The filter is optional, and if not set anything is accepted.
necronomicon.text.itemtransportsystem.6: When you're in the "Apply Configuration" mode, sneak right-click on the block you wish to transport items from. Side matters, so keep that in mind if the block only extracts from one side.
necronomicon.text.itemtransportsystem.7: When you're in the "Remove Configuration" mode, you can remove all applied configurations from a block by sneak right-clicking them. Breaking and placing the block would do the same thing, but this saves you time in comparison.
necronomicon.text.itemtransportsystem.8: There are two utility spells (named "Display Routes" and "Toll The Bell") which can aid you in keeping track of defined routes, and also starting/stopping them. "Display Routes" will reveal any active routes in your vicinity, and "Toll The Bell" will start or stop routes from the block you're looking at (or all nearby if not targeting one).
necronomicon.text.itemtransportsystem.9: Une flamme bleue dans la vasque dorée indique que l'autel est actif. La Tablette spirituelle permet d'interagir avec l'Autel spirituel.
necronomicon.text.itemtransportsystem.10: Maj + clic droit affiche les routes connectées. En mode « Tracer un chemin », l'Autel spirituel cherche les routes proches ; « Appliquer la configuration » les démarre ou les arrête, et « Retirer la configuration » les efface.
necronomicon.information.omothol.title: L'Omothol
necronomicon.text.omothol: Une cyclopéenne cité infinie construite à la frontière du réel, le Royaume de J'zahar représente l'unique passage vers le lieu d'exil des Grands Anciens. Mais le Gardien des Abysses veille, et personne n'est jamais ressorti de la dernière dimension des Abysses vivant.
Once you have reached the Dark Realm, there isn't much to do down here apart from facing infinite waves of Shadow beings and Sacthoth, as this is his natural habitant.
Main reason to intentionally fall down here would be to obtain large quantities of Shadow Gems and/or Sacthoth's Soul Reaper Blade.
necronomicon.text.entity.sacthoth.1: Sacthoth, Harbinger of Doom is found in The Dark Realm.
necronomicon.text.entity.sacthoth.2: Sacthoth is the strongest being in The Dark Realm, and the ruler of living shadows. The only way for him to leave The Dark Realm is through the explosion of a Oblivion Deathbomb. He carries a powerful sword capable of tearing out the souls of the living.
necronomicon.text.entity.shadowghoul.1: Informations sur les goules de l'ombre
necronomicon.text.entity.shadowghoul.2: Plus d'informations sur les goules de l'ombre
necronomicon.information.darkrealm.title: Le Royaume des Ombres
necronomicon.text.darkrealm: Des univers en-dessous de l'Omothol se situe un monde désolé où reposent les Âmes de démons, en attente de leur réincarnation. Le Royaume de l'Ombre est là où naissent les Ombres, et le dernier endroit qu'une Âme vivante devrait visiter à cause de la souffrance éternelle qui les y attend.
Avec la Clé d'argent, le Rituel des Portes ouvertes n'est plus nécessaire. Fabriquez des Ancres de portail et placez-les où vous le souhaitez.
Un rituel permet aussi de créer une Ancre de portail sans restriction, en brisant les chaînes éthérées qui limitent les portails aux dimensions reliées.
necronomicon.text.rituals.1: In order to get started with rituals you need to create the altar to perform them at. There is a total of 8 materials you can create your Ritual Altar from.
necronomicon.text.rituals.2: Those are: Cobblestone, Darkstone Cobblestone, Abyssal Cobblestone, Coralium Cobblestone, Dreadstone Cobblestone, Abyssalnite Cobblestone, Ethaxium Brick and Dark Ethaxium Brick. The materials can only be used in their specific dimension (eg. Cobblestone and Darkstone Cobblestone in the Overworld, Abyssal Cobblestone in the Abyssal Wasteland etc).
necronomicon.text.rituals.3: To create the altar, simply place the blocks in the above formation (keep the colored area clear) and shift right-click the center block with a Necronomicon.
necronomicon.text.rituals.4: After that, you can start performing rituals! In order to perform a ritual, place objects on the pedestals and shift right-click the altar with a Necronomicon.
necronomicon.text.rituals.5: When performing, the pedestals project bits of their placed object towards the altar. Rituals where you gain objects always end with a bolt of lightning striking the altar.
necronomicon.text.rituals.6: Potential Energy is required in order to perform rituals (each ritual entry shows how much you need). Potential Energy is a pure form of untapped energy originating from a higher plane of existence. It's mainly used to fuel sacrifices made to The Great Old Ones (any ritual). Statues placed on Shoggoth Monoliths are said to be capable of draining it.
necronomicon.text.rituals.7: Some rituals require a living sacrifice. This means you need to have an adult animal within close proximity of the altar and pedestals. When the ritual starts, the target animal will begin to glow, and needs to die before the ritual ends. Failing to complete a ritual will trigger a Disruption, which is bad.
The Ritual Altar is the main component in performing rituals. It's used by shift right-clicking on it with a Necronomicon that has sufficient Potential Energy. For successful rituals, the nearby Ritual Pedestals will need the correct offerings placed on them.
necronomicon.text.materials.ritualpedest: Ritual Pedestals are used to place offerings when performing rituals. This is done by interacting with the pedestal while holding the offering you wish to place.
necronomicon.text.materials.monolithston: Monolith Stone is a material used to some extent with Potential Energy. It's origins are unknown, other than that Shoggoths are capable of creating it. It can be obtained from Monoliths or Shoggoth Lairs scattered about.
necronomicon.text.crafting.energypedesta: A Energy Pedestal is crafted with Monolith Stones, A Shadow Gem and a Coralium Pearl.

This block serves as a method for obtaining Potential Energy. If you place Statues 3 blocks away from it (on the x or z axis), they will transfer energy to it at a fast rate. Place a Necronomicon (or other source that can hold Potential Energy) on it in order to drain it.
necronomicon.text.crafting.monolithpilla: A Monolith Stone Pillar is crafted with Monolith Stone. It's primary use is to amplify the range of Potential Energy Manipulators (statues for example).
necronomicon.text.crafting.ritualcharm.1: A Ritual Charm is crafted with Gold Ingots and a Diamond. By itself it has no effect, but through rituals it can amplify various stats of Potential Energy Manipulators.
necronomicon.text.crafting.sacrificialal: A Sacrificial Altar is crafted with Shadow Fragments, Monolith Stone, A Shadow Gem and a Coralium Pearl. They convert life-force into Potential Energy.

When an mob is targeted, it will start glowing. Once the mob dies, an amount of PE equal to it's max health will be collected. It only targets non-undead adult mobs that aren't players. It should be noted that the altar goes on a cooldown after collecting a fifth of it's max capacity, preventing collection for a minute.
necronomicon.text.crafting.energycollect: A Energy Collector is crafted with Monolith Stone and a Shadow Gem. They can collect PE, but require a Energy Relay to transport it.
necronomicon.text.crafting.energyrelay: A Energy Relay is crafted with Monolith Stone, Shadow Gem Shards and a Shadow Gem. They can be used to transport PE between blocks capable of storing it.
necronomicon.text.crafting.rendingpedest: A Rending Pedestal is crafted with Monolith Stone, A Shard of Oblivion and a Coralium Pearl. They can be used to automate the Staff of Rending.
necronomicon.text.crafting.stonetablet: A Stone Tablet is crafted with Monolith Stone, Shadow Gem Shards and a Shadow Gem. Can be used in the State Transformer and Energy Depositioner in order to generate PE.
necronomicon.text.crafting.statetransfor: A State Transformer is crafted with Monolith Stone, a Transmutation Gem and a Chest. It allows you to store input objects as PE in a Stone Tablet.

Fill the input slots with stacks of items, then place a empty Stone Tablet in the leftmost slot to fill it. Press the button to switch modes, allowing you to reverse the process, returning items previously stored in a Stone Tablet. The amount of PE per input item is 1 * (64/max stack size) PE/item. Input/output can be automated.
necronomicon.text.crafting.energydeposit: A Energy Depositioner is crafted with Monolith Stone, Shadow Gems, a Transmutation Gem and a Energy Relay. This is a PE manipulator, working like statues.

By placing a charged Stone Tablet in the input slot, the Depositioner will siphon out any PE stored in it, returning either a empty Stone Tablet or a cursed one. This operation will corrupt the surrounding area (17x17 blocks), converting it into Darklands (more Darklands increases the chance of cursed Stone Tablets). Output can be automated.
necronomicon.text.pe.1: Potential Energy (PE) is a new form of energy presented in AbyssalCraft. It originates from a higher plane of existence (where no mortal has wandered), and can only be collected by tapping into Ley Lines using various methods. There exist objects capable of doing so, which will be explained here.
necronomicon.text.pe.2: A good place to start obtaining materials required to create some of the PE collecting objects is Shoggoth Lairs, found in swamps and rivers.
necronomicon.text.pe.3: Shoggoth Monoliths are also constructed with Monolith Stone (hence the name), while having statues placed on them. These statues can collect PE.
necronomicon.text.pe.4: It should be noted that the Lesser Shoggoths only build these monoliths under certain conditions. Theorists claim it has to do with power positions (but they're genderless, and don't understand the concept of hieracrchy). If 6 (or more) Lesser Shoggoths are within 32 blocks of each other, one is prone to rise a monolith out of the ooze.
necronomicon.text.pe.5: You should take into account that the Lesser Shoggoths have no limit on how many monoliths they construct, leading to a possible infestation.
necronomicon.text.pe.6: If you notice Shoggoth activity near your homestead, it is highly advised that you immediately evacuate your land, or construct a large wall (or other defensive measures) to ensure the infestation doesn't spread onto your land. Recovering your land from a Shoggoth infestation is quite difficult, so be cautious.
necronomicon.text.pe.7: The statues come in different shapes, all depicting Great Old Ones. They can transport PE to nearby players holding Necronomicons when under open sky.
necronomicon.text.pe.8: It should be noted that you harvesting PE isn't appreciated. This causes disruptions to occur (displayed by a bolt of lightning striking the statue, or other PE manipulator). Disruptions are random events that can affect the player, other entities or the environment. Their purpose is to punish those who tries to drain PE from the higher plane.
necronomicon.text.pe.9: Statues have a limited PE transfer range to nearby collectors. Collectors need to be placed in the yellow frame (with a two block gap between it and the statue).
necronomicon.text.pe.10: When placed on Monolith Stone Pillar Blocks, the statues range can be increased up to two blocks. Statues on pillars can transfer energy to Collectors further down.
necronomicon.text.pe.11: A Energy Depositioner is another PE manipulator. It works like a generator, where the "fuel" are Stone Tablets charged with PE.
necronomicon.text.pe.12: One way to boost the efficiency of statues (and other PE manipulators) is through the use of Ritual Charms. They can boost various stats (check the tooltip).
necronomicon.text.pe.13: You can also craft a Energy Pedestal, which can collect PE from statues (and other PE manipulators). Items that can hold PE can be placed on the pedestal to charge.
necronomicon.text.pe.14: Along with the Energy Pedestal there's the Sacrificial Altar, which can convert life-force from dying mobs into PE (targeted mobs glow).
necronomicon.text.pe.15: Another way to collect PE from manipulators is with a Energy Collector. It works like a Energy Pedestal (except you can't place items on it).
necronomicon.text.pe.16: Energy Relays are used to transfer PE, and can do so in any direction (but it can't transport it through solid blocks, except glass).
necronomicon.text.pe.17: Building networks with Energy Relays allows you to transport PE over larger distances. Energy Relays can drain PE from PE Collector placed next to it.
necronomicon.text.pe.18: In order to store greater amounts of PE, you can create a Energy Container. They allow insertion through Energy Relays or interaction with the block.
necronomicon.text.pe.19: If the PE production still is too slow, you can also upgrade the various PE handling blocks through infusion rituals to boost stats.
necronomicon.text.placesofpower.1: Places of Power are shrine-like structures built to show devotion to the Great Old Ones. These sites of worship spread the word of the Great Old Ones, while also enabling harvesting of PE without disruptions. Along with the safe retrieval of energy, these structures can also boost various stats of the statues contained in them.
necronomicon.text.placesofpower.2: In the structures section you can view the structures you've gained knowledge on how to build, their dimensions and what stats they amplify (if any). The point where you form the structure (by sneak right-clicking it with your Necronomicon) will change block in the preview to indicate where it is. Hovering over the preview shows a list of blocks used to build it.
necronomicon.text.idols.info: Les Idoles utilisent la PE pour accomplir des actions précises lorsqu'une source de PE est disponible. On les trouve dans les sanctuaires de Pierre sombre abritant des statues. Chaque Idole possède ses propres conditions en plus de la PE.
necronomicon.text.materials.idoloffading: L'Idole d'effacement utilise la PE pour invoquer des Ombres vivantes du Royaume sombre. Chaque invocation coûte 25, 50 ou 100 PE selon la créature. Elle n'agit que sans vue du ciel et avec un joueur à moins de 32 blocs.
necronomicon.text.crafting.odbcore: A ODB Core is crafted with Abyssalnite Ingots, Iron Ingots, Iron Blocks and a Coralium Pearl. Can be used as an explosive.
necronomicon.text.crafting.odb: A Oblivion Deathbomb is crafted with Obsidian, A ODB Core, A Oblivion Catalyst, a Liquid Coralium Bucket and a Liquid Antimatter Bucket. Heavy explosive.
necronomicon.text.crafting.carboncluster: A Carbon Cluster is crafted with Crystallized Carbon. They are used in order to craft Dense Carbon Clusters.
necronomicon.text.crafting.densecarboncl: A Dense Carbon Cluster is crafted with Carbon Clusters and a block of Obsidian. Can be transmuted into a Diamond.
necronomicon.text.crafting.crate: A Wooden Crate is crafted with Sticks, Wooden Planks and a Chest. Has an extra row of inventory slots more than a Chest.
necronomicon.text.enchantment.lightpierc: The Light Pierce Enchantment works like Bane of Arthropods, but on Shadow mobs.
necronomicon.text.enchantment.ironwall: The Iron Wall Enchantment works as a anti-knockback enchantment, repelling knockback applied when hit.
necronomicon.text.enchantment.sapping: The Sapping Enchantment increases the amount of energy a Staff of Rending can drain.
necronomicon.text.enchantment.multirend: The Multi-rend Enchantment makes the Staff of Rending also drain energy from nearby mobs within a 3 block radius of the target.
necronomicon.text.enchantment.blindingli: L'enchantement Lumière aveuglante permet au bouclier d'absorber les dégâts des ténèbres, rendant les combats contre les Bêtes de l'ombre plus supportables.
necronomicon.text.crafting.decorativeaza: A Decorative Azathoth Statue is crafted with Monolith Stone, Clay and Purple Dye.
necronomicon.text.crafting.decorativecth: A Decorative Cthulhu Statue is crafted with Monolith Stone, Clay and Cyan Dye.
necronomicon.text.crafting.decorativehas: A Decorative Hastur Statue is crafted with Monolith Stone, Clay and Dandelion Yellow.
necronomicon.text.crafting.decorativejza: A Decorative J'zahar Statue is crafted with Monolith Stone, Clay and Gray Dye.
necronomicon.text.crafting.decorativenya: A Decorative Nyarlathotep Statue is crafted with Monolith Stone, Clay and Lapis Lazuli.
necronomicon.text.crafting.decorativeyog: A Decorative Yog-Sothoth Statue is crafted with Monolith Stone, Clay and Glowstone Dust.
necronomicon.text.crafting.decorativeshu: A Decorative Shub-Niggurath Statue is crafted with Monolith Stone, Clay and a Ink Sac.
necronomicon.text.spells.1: In order to get started with spells you need to obtain some scrolls to inscribe the spells onto. Most of the available scrolls (except the greater) can be created through rituals or bought from Remnants. Spells in the compendium show which scroll they require (if the center slot is empty you can use any scroll).
necronomicon.text.spells.2: Currently the quality of the scroll used has no impact on the inscribed spell, but in a future update some aspects of a spell will improve depending on which scroll you use. The unique scrolls will likely do something beyond that.
necronomicon.text.spells.3: Spellcasting is done by right-clicking while holding an inscribed scroll (you also need an item that holds PE in your inventory for the casting to tap into). If the spell type is "Charging", you need to hold down the mouse button for 3 seconds, otherwise it's instant. Depending on the spell, you might need to target something specific while casting.
necronomicon.text.abyssalcraft.1: AbyssalCraft est le mod à travers duquel ce livre va vous guider. Le mod est majoritairement orienté exploration, avec 4 nouvelles dimensions à explorer.
necronomicon.text.abyssalcraft.2: Les dimensions peuvent être visitées grâce aux "Clés", qui sont des outils dédiés à créer des portails entre les dimensions (la 4ème dimension est atteinte en tombant dans le vide de la 3ème).
necronomicon.text.abyssalcraft.3: un total de 6 nouveaux biomes se génèrent à la Surface: les Terres de l'Ombre (normal, plaines, forêt, collines et montagnes) et les Marécages Infestés.
necronomicon.text.abyssalcraft.4: Il y a également 5 nouvelles roches et 15 nouveaux minerais éparpillés à travers toutes les dimensions.
necronomicon.text.abyssalcraft.5: En-dehors de l'exploration, AbyssalCraft introduit un nouveau type de magie, les "Rituels", destinés à vénérer les Grands Anciens.
necronomicon.text.abyssalcraft.6: Il y a également des machines, permettant de transmuter, cristallizer et matérialiser des objets variés. Il y a également une presse à monnaie.
necronomicon.text.necronomicon.1: Ce livre est le Necronomicon, un livre écrit par Abdul Alhazred, plus connu sous le nom de "l'Arabe Fou". Le livre contient des informations sur les Grands Anciens, leurs noms et comment les réveiller. Il y a aussi des informations sur les rituels et sorts que ce livre permet de faire.
necronomicon.text.necronomicon.2: Le necronomicon en lui-même est un chapitre de l'Abyssalnomicon, qui fut lu à Alhazred par un démon connu sous le nom de J'zahar, qui écrit l'Abyssalnomicon à partir de connaissances infinies connues seulement des Grands Anciens.
necronomicon.text.necronomicon.3: Il existe 4 types de Necronomicons dans l'Abyssalnomicon: le Necronomicon, le Necronomicon des landes Abyssales, le Necronomicon des Dreadlands et le Necronomicon de l'Omothol, chacun contenant du savoir spécifique à chaque dimension.
necronomicon.text.necronomicon.4: Pour découvrir ce savoir, il faut voyager dans ladite dimension et enchanter le Necronomicon avec la chair de ce monde. L'Abyssalnomicon contient des connaissances supplémentaires que seul J'zahar connaît, du savoir qu'aucun homme n'est censé savoir.
necronomicon.text.abyssalnomicon.1: Ce livre est l'Abyssalnomicon, un livre écrit par J'zahar, Gardien des Abysses. Le livre contient des connaissances venant des quatre Necronomicons, qui sont en réalité des chapitres de ce livre. Il y a aussi des connaissances supplémentaires non mentionnées dans les autres.
necronomicon.text.abyssalnomicon.2: Les informations sur les sorts et rituels des autres Necronomicons sont limitées à celles de chaque dimension (et les précédentes dépendant du type de Necronomicon); l'Abyssalnomicon contient tout leur savoir en un seul livre, avec des suppléments.
necronomicon.text.knowledge.1: Some information in this book is incomprehensible to your puny, regular, untwisted mortal mind. By studying artifacts, listening to the whispers from statues, defeat monsters and explore the surroundings, you can expand your mind with new knowledge, enabling you to comprehend the information. Some Items and Blocks also require knowledge in order to be comprehended.
necronomicon.text.knowledge.2: Treasure chests can contain lost pages with information, and in old structures scattered about, you can uncover murals that will grant you knowledge. Statues depicting Great Old Ones can sometimes be heard whispering things. Through combat you can gain knowledge of the enemy after defeating it. Exploring biomes and dimensions will grant you new knowledge.
necronomicon.text.knowledge.3: Information you can't comprehend appears in Aklo glyphs rather than the human alphabet. The following page has an example of such glyphs:
necronomicon.text.knowledge.aklo: Au-delà des étoiles noyées, les archives silencieuses s'ouvrent. Ne prononcez aucun nom devant leur porte. Suivez la marée noire à travers neuf salles tournoyantes sans porter de flamme ; ce qui attend dessous se souvient de chaque lumière entrée.
necronomicon.text.machines.1: The Transmutator is used to transmute objects into other objects, which can revert a process or simply convert an object into it's opposite. It's fueled by any Coralium materials, Coralium-plagued Flesh and any Crystallized element (full crystal or shard).
necronomicon.text.machines.2: The Crystallizer is used to crystallize elements, isolating the base elements (or molecules) they're made from. It's fueled by any Dreaded material, Dread Fragments and any Crystallized element (full crystal or shard).
necronomicon.text.machines.3: The Engraver is used to engrave coins, allowing you to trade things with Remnant. The "fuel" used in engraving is engraving templates, that wear out after a certain amount of uses. If you want to re-engrave a coin, you have to use a blank engraving on it first (to un-engrave it).
necronomicon.text.machines.4: The Materializer is used to create objects by combining base elements (obtained through crystallization). The Materializer uses no fuel, but requires a Necronomicon to function, and a Crystal Bag with crystals to materialize objects from.
necronomicon.text.ritualcharms.1: Les Charmes rituels renforcent temporairement certaines caractéristiques des manipulateurs d'Énergie Potentielle. Le charme de base retire les amplificateurs existants. Tout amplificateur augmente la production de PE, et celui de puissance l'augmente davantage.
necronomicon.text.ritualcharms.2: Lorsqu'une Statue est amplifiée, le symbole de l'amplificateur, identique à celui du charme, apparaît sur le socle.
necronomicon.text.peupgrading.1: Si la production de PE reste trop lente, améliorez les blocs manipulant la PE sur une enclume avec des Anneaux dimensionnels afin d'augmenter leurs caractéristiques.
necronomicon.text.peupgrading.2: L'anneau de base se fabrique avec des lingots d'or et de la poudre de Blaze, puis s'améliore pour chaque palier grâce aux rituels.
necronomicon.text.peupgrading.3: L'anneau correspondant au palier apparaît sur chaque bloc amélioré.
